## Summary

This website does not collect personal data. There are no forms, user accounts, logins,
or comment functions, and no marketing or analytics trackers are installed.

## Cookies

This site sets no cookies of its own.

::: {.team-note}
**To verify before publication**
Confirm that no embedded third-party content (video players, fonts, maps) sets cookies.
If web fonts are loaded from an external provider, either self-host them or disclose the
transfer here.
:::

## Server logs

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. As with any web host, the hosting infrastructure
records technical request data, including IP addresses, for security and abuse
prevention. This processing is carried out by the hosting provider and is not accessible
to, or used by, the EuroCOMP Lab.

## Contacting us

If you contact the team by email, your message and address are used only to respond to
your enquiry and are not used for any other purpose.

## Your rights

::: {.team-note}
**To complete**
Name the data controller, give a contact point for data protection questions, and state
the applicable framework. For World Bank activities this differs from the GDPR position
that applies to EU institutions, so this section needs a definitive answer rather than
boilerplate.
:::

## Changes to this statement

Any changes will be published on this page with a revised date.
